scope: Final Stage-2 VA000051 and PRL000292 were preserved as one profile/software-index resource for the repeated ARTL and JDA mappings; both linked official archives were retrieved and inspected statically, yielding two method experiments and four active driver configurations.

unresolved_findings.finding: Neither archive states an archive-level license for the ARTL/JDA method source or bundled MAT data; ARTL's LIBLINEAR COPYRIGHT applies only to that bundled third-party component.
The archives identify MATLAB source but provide no MATLAB version, required toolbox list, complete dependency manifest or top-level installation procedure.
JDA.m adds ../liblinear/matlab to the MATLAB path, but the referenced directory is absent from the JDA archive; the inspected active JDA paths do not otherwise call LIBLINEAR directly.
The ARTL and JDA drivers compute or write target accuracies, but neither archive supplies reference expected results for the active configurations.
ARTL run.m assigns std(Accs) to a variable named stderr, so the source label implies standard error while the implemented statistic is standard deviation.

notes: The MAT payloads were not loaded, and no scientific software, dataset, test or benchmark was executed.
